title: IoT 기록
description: readings 저장 확인용. 컬럼을 가공하지 않고 그대로 보여 주며, 컬럼이 늘거나 줄면 표에 자동으로 반영됩니다. 일상 조회는 Home Assistant 에서 합니다.

list.label: site

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT processing FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT processing FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site)

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT property FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR property IN ($property)) AND value IS NOT NULL AND lower(coalesce(value_text, '')) NOT IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline') AND property NOT LIKE 'pm%'

panels.title: readings 컬럼
panels.description: information_schema 에서 읽은 readings 의 현재 컬럼입니다. Telegraf 가 새 태그로 컬럼을 추가하거나 마이그레이션으로 빠지면 바로 바뀝니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ordinal_position, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'readings'
ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT chunk_name, range_start, range_end, is_compressed
FROM timescaledb_information.chunks
WHERE hypertable_name = 'readings'
ORDER BY range_start DESC

panels.title: 기기·속성별 최신 행
panels.description: 선택한 기간에서 site·room·device·anchor·property 마다 마지막으로 저장된 행을 모든 컬럼 그대로 보여 줍니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (site, room, device, anchor, property, processing) *
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR property IN ($property))
ORDER BY site, room, device, anchor, property, processing, time DESC

panels.title: 최근 행
panels.description: 선택한 기간에서 가장 최근에 저장된 500행을 모든 컬럼 그대로 보여 줍니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT *
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR property IN ($property))
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: 미세먼지
panels.description: 이름이 pm 으로 시작하는 속성(pm1, pm25, pm10 …)을 한 그래프에 그립니다. 시리즈 라벨은 site·room·device·anchor·property·unit 컬럼 값입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), site, room, device, anchor, property, processing, unit, avg(value) AS value
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR property IN ($property)) AND property LIKE 'pm%' AND value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $num_property
panels.description: 숫자 값(value)이 있는 속성마다 패널이 하나씩 생깁니다(pm 속성은 위 미세먼지 그래프). on/off·true/false·online/offline 같은 두 값 상태는 아래 상태 타임라인에 나옵니다. 시리즈 라벨은 site·room·device·anchor·processing·unit 컬럼 값입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), site, room, device, anchor, processing, unit, avg(value) AS value
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND property = ${num_property:sqlstring} AND value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $text_property
panels.description: 문자열 속성(air_quality 등)과 두 값 상태 속성(presence, contact, availability 등)마다 패널이 하나씩 생깁니다. 켜짐·참·온라인은 노랑, 꺼짐·거짓·오프라인은 회색입니다(contact 는 true 가 닫힘). 기기를 옮기거나 이름을 바꿔 그 이름의 기록이 끝난 뒤는 빈 칸입니다. 기기마다 한 줄이고 행 이름은 지역과 기기 이름(방-종류[-위치], 원본이 아니면 processing 을 덧붙임)입니다.

targets.rawSql:
-- 기록이 끝난 이름(같은 실물 hw_id 가 뒤에 다른 이름으로 기록됨)은 그 시각에 빈 값을 넣어 막대를 끊습니다. 없으면 마지막 값이 패널 끝까지 이어집니다
WITH r AS (
  SELECT time, hw_id, site, room, device, anchor,
         concat_ws(' ', site, concat_ws('-', room, device, anchor), nullif(processing, 'raw')) AS name,
         CASE WHEN lower(value_text) IN ('on', 'off', 'true', 'false', 'online', 'offline') THEN lower(value_text) ELSE value_text END AS value_text
  FROM readings
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND processing IN ($processing) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND (device <> 'host' OR device IN ($device)) AND property = ${text_property:sqlstring} AND value_text IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT time, name, value_text FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT n.time, e.name, NULL
FROM (SELECT name, hw_id, site, room, device, anchor, max(time) AS last FROM r WHERE hw_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.time FROM readings x
  WHERE x.hw_id = e.hw_id AND x.time >= e.last AND x.time <= $__timeTo()
    AND (x.site, x.room, x.device, x.anchor) IS DISTINCT FROM (e.site, e.room, e.device, e.anchor)
  ORDER BY x.time LIMIT 1) n
ORDER BY 1
